sn12.11:1.2: On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Savatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anathapiṇḍika’s Park….
sn12.11:1.3: “Bhikkhus, there are these four kinds of nutriment for the maintenance of beings that have already come to be and for the assistance of those about to come to be.
sn12.11:1.5: The nutriment edible food, gross or subtle; second, contact; third, mental volition; fourth, consciousness.
sn12.11:1.6: These are the four kinds of nutriment for the maintenance of beings that have already come to be and for the assistance of those about to come to be.
sn12.11:2.1: “Bhikkhus, these four kinds of nutriment have what as their source, what as their origin, from what are they born and produced?
sn12.11:2.2: These four kinds of nutriment have craving as their source, craving as their origin; they are born and produced from craving.
sn12.11:2.3: “And this craving has what as its source, what as its origin, from what is it born and produced?
sn12.11:2.4: This craving has feeling as its source, feeling as its origin; it is born and produced from feeling.
sn12.11:2.5: “And this feeling has what as its source…?
sn12.11:2.6: Feeling has contact as its source….
sn12.11:2.7: And this contact has what as its source…?
sn12.11:2.8: Contact has the six sense bases as its source….
sn12.11:2.9: And these six sense bases have what as their source…?
sn12.11:2.10: The six sense bases have name-and-form as their source….
sn12.11:2.11: And this name-and-form has what as its source…? Name-and-form has consciousness as its source….
sn12.11:2.13: And this consciousness has what as its source…?
sn12.11:2.14: Consciousness has volitional formations as its source….
sn12.11:2.15: And these volitional formations have what as their source, what as their origin, from what are they born and produced?
sn12.11:2.16: Volitional formations have ignorance as their source, ignorance as their origin; they are born and produced from ignorance.
sn12.11:3.1: “Thus, bhikkhus, with ignorance as condition, volitional formations come to be;
sn12.11:3.2: with volitional formations as condition, consciousness….
sn12.11:3.3: Such is the origin of this whole mass of suffering.
sn12.11:3.4: But with the remainderless fading away and cessation of ignorance comes cessation of volitional formations; with the cessation of volitional formations,
sn12.11:3.6: Such is the cessation of this whole mass of suffering.”
